Strict whitespace mode preserves whitespace as-is

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Preserved   spacing.</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(whitespace_mode: 'Strict'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
